property_summary: For any call to fallback with msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, the reference contract always ends with address(c).balance == 0 whenever it executes the branch sending funds to msg.sender (i.e., when block.number % 15 == 0 and the recipient revert causes transfer to revert the whole call), whereas the mutant that uses send may leave a nonzero balance because it ignores a failed send; the test fuzzes the caller address and a boolean that chooses whether the recipient reverts to expose this difference.
change_summary: Replace transfer(address(this).balance) with a send(...) that returns a bool and ignore its false result, which can cause different revert behavior when the transfer fails.
